rationale: The assistant reached useful actions (refill rinse aid, raise the dose, leave the door ajar), but opened by calling the behaviour a fault ('it is not normal... indicates a fault') when plastics staying wet is expected. It never clearly explained that plastics hold little heat until the final turn. It also contradicted itself, first suggesting a different programme, then saying 'no further immediate action required' while the customer keeps using Eco 50, and it made an unsupported claim about all-in-ones lacking rinse aid and salt. It repeated the 'most likely cause' line and ignored the customer's earlier mention of opening the door immediately, though it did later advise the door-ajar approach.
